info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Approved Supplier Validation API
info.description: The Approved Supplier Validation API allows businesses to submit and validate supplier information within the approved supplier directory. This endpoint is crucial for organizations seeking to ensure compliance and maintain quality control when engaging with suppliers. Typical consumers include procurement teams, finance departments, and compliance officers who need to verify supplier credentials. By streamlining the validation process, companies can mitigate risk and enhance their supplier relationships.

post.summary: Create a validation for an approved supplier.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a validation entry for an approved supplier in the directory. It ensures that the supplier meets all necessary criteria for validation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a validation process for an approved supplier within the specified enterprise service. It should include all necessary information about the supplier and the validation parameters required for processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, validation data returned.
